description: Points GPS délimitant les zones réglementées autour de Port-Cros is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This layer includes all the geographical coordinates that allowed the delimitation of the zones prohibited to navigation, anchorage, scuba diving and the practice of water sports of speed in the coastal strip of 600 meters around Port-Cros, in accordance with the draft Order 04/17 and its previous orders. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "GPS points delimiting restricted areas around Port-Cros" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Zone de gestion, Île de Port-Cros, Coordonnées. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
